statement:
The payment record indicates a monthly salary of USD 6,200 and an active status for employee J. Okafor, but shows the bank account holder was changed this week to K. Lindqvist, requiring the pay to be placed on hold.
The payment for employee E-2044 (J. Okafor) has been placed on hold due to a discrepancy with the bank account holder name being changed to K. Lindqvist this week.
judge_text:
WRONG

It asserts a specific defect blocking payment — "placed on hold due to a discrepancy with the bank account holder name being changed to K. Lindqvist this week" — rather than merely asking for verification (though it misses the 14-month/this-week date contradiction).
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
